args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%). Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Service is now healthy with error rate ~0.2%. Initial rollback attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after us-east); a retry completed the rollback across all regions.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` (unhealthy, ~18% error rate) across all regions. The most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions. The first attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after `us-east`), so I retried and the rollback completed across `us-east`, `us-west`, and `eu-west`. The service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: The `create_incident` call returned a timeout, but I verified via `list_incidents` that the incident was actually created — **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy", SEV2, status open) with a summary describing the rollback.
